Name: Ghallok's Improved Forest Farm
Author: Ghallok
Description:
Features:

[list=1]
[*]All tiles tillable!
[*]water troughs refill watering can!
[*]southeast is designated for barns/coops (you can place anywhere if you want tho)
[*]Forage spawns daily
[*]13 berry bushes for all your berry needs lol!
[*]FARM ACTS AS A GREENHOUSE, YOU CAN PLANT ANYTHING ANYTIME!!
[/list]
I created this map because I really like the standard forest farm, but I feel like there isn't enough room to do much, so I came up with this mod! All the grass is tillable, which means you can put buildings/crops on the west side where the forage spawns if you really want to! There are 13 berry bushes on the farm.
